source: Le Figaro personal column, 1877, ads signed V. T. A. (scans in data/sources/figaro/images, from Didier Muller's database). Enciphered words transcribed by eye from the scans, Round 36. Plain words of each ad are kept as context. '+' is the printed cross (also printed as -1-). Glyph pairs that differ only slightly in this typeface (1/l, o/0, t/f) were read as printed where clear; uncertain ones are listed under 'ambiguous'.
